name: 上緣分隔線＋置中標題與副標
desc: 區塊上緣一條橫跨畫面的分隔線，下方置中放標題與副標，上方留白明顯大於下方，適合當下一段內容的開頭。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上緣有一條橫跨畫面寬的分隔線。分隔線下方置中放大標題（可多行），下方是一段置中的副標，標題明顯大於副標，兩者都只佔畫面寬的一小部分；副標可省略，沒有時省略，標題的位置不變。上方留白明顯大於下方，文字集中在區塊下半部。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放；分隔線仍橫跨畫面寬，標題與副標維持置中，上方留白仍大於下方。

en.name: Top divider + centered title and subheading
en.desc: A divider spanning the viewport along the top edge of the section, with a centered title and subheading below; the space above is clearly larger than below, suiting it as the opener for the following content.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. A divider spanning the viewport width runs along the top edge of the section. Below the divider, centered, place a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) with a centered subheading below it; the headline is clearly larger than the subheading, and both take up only a small part of the viewport width. The subheading is optional; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the headline. The space above is clearly larger than below, so the text sits in the lower half of the section.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally; the divider still spans the viewport width, the headline and subheading stay centered, and the space above remains larger than below.
